        original = Image.open(high_res_file_name)
        (width, height) = original.size
        diameter = math.sqrt(math.pow(width, 2) + math.pow(height, 2))
        width /= diameter
        height /= diameter
        width *= IMAGE_SCALE
        height *= IMAGE_SCALE
        cropped = original.resize((int(width), int(height)), PIL.Image.LANCZOS)
        cropped.save(low_res_file_name)
        m.text = text
        m.cachedText = compile_markdown(text)
        m.category = category
        m.highResFile = '/' + high_res_file_name
        m.lowResFile = '/' + low_res_file_name
        m.headline = headline
        m.save()

def _delete_vdisk(self, aug_v14, aug_v10):
    """Deletes existing vdisks.

    It is very important to properly take care of mappings before deleting
    the disk:
    1. If no mappings, then it was a vdisk, and can be deleted
    2. If it is the source of a flashcopy mapping and copy_rate is 0, then
       it is a vdisk that has a snapshot.  If the force flag is set,
       delete the mapping and the vdisk, otherwise set the mapping to
       copy and wait (this will allow users to delete vdisks that have
       snapshots if/when the upper layers allow it).
    3. If it is the target of a mapping and copy_rate is 0, it is a
       snapshot, and we should properly stop the mapping and delete.
    4. If it is the source/target of a mapping and copy_rate is not 0, it
       is a clone or vdisk created from a snapshot.  We wait for the copy
       to complete (the mapping will be autodeleted) and then delete the
       vdisk.

    """
    LOG.debug(_('enter: _delete_vdisk: vdisk %s') % aug_v14)
    aug_v12 = self._is_vdisk_defined(aug_v14)
    if not aug_v12:
        LOG.info(_('warning: Tried to delete vdisk %s but it does not exist.') % aug_v14)
        return
    self._ensure_vdisk_no_fc_mappings(aug_v14)
    aug_v20 = ['svctask', 'rmvdisk', '-force', aug_v14]
    if not aug_v10:
        aug_v20.remove('-force')
    (aug_v18, aug_v16) = self._run_ssh(aug_v20)
    self._assert_ssh_return(len(aug_v18.strip()) == 0, '_delete_vdisk %(name)s' % {'name': aug_v14}, aug_v20, aug_v18, aug_v16)
    LOG.debug(_('leave: _delete_vdisk: vdisk %s') % aug_v14)

            - release: osrelease
          pillar:

    """

    aug_v12 = {}
    salt.modules.config.__opts__ = __opts__
    aug_v14 = __salt__['config.get']('custom_grains_pillar:grains', [])
    for aug_v16 in aug_v14:
        for aug_v22 in aug_v16:
            if _valid_command(aug_v16[aug_v22]):
                aug_v24 = __salt__['cmd.run']('salt-call grains.get {0}'.format(aug_v16[aug_v22])).split('\n')[1].strip()
                aug_v12[aug_v22] = aug_v24
    aug_v18 = __salt__['config.get']('custom_grains_pillar:pillar', [])
    for aug_v20 in aug_v18:
        for aug_v22 in aug_v20:
            if _valid_command(aug_v20[aug_v22]):
                aug_v24 = __salt__['cmd.run']('salt-call pillar.get {0}'.format(aug_v20[aug_v22])).split('\n')[1].strip()

def _map_vol_to_host(self, volume_name, host_name):
    """Create a mapping between a volume to a host."""
    LOG.debug(_('enter: _map_vol_to_host: volume %(volume_name)s to host %(host_name)s') % {'volume_name': volume_name, 'host_name': host_name})
    aug_v500 = self._get_hostvdisk_mappings(host_name)
    mapping_data = aug_v500
    mapped_flag = False
    result_lun = '-1'
    if volume_name in mapping_data:
        mapped_flag = True
        aug_v501 = mapping_data[volume_name]['SCSI_id']
        result_lun = aug_v501
    else:
        aug_v502 = [int(v['SCSI_id']) for v in mapping_data.values()]
        lun_used = aug_v502
        lun_used.sort()
        aug_v503 = str(len(lun_used))
        result_lun = aug_v503
        for (index, n) in enumerate(lun_used):
            if n > index:
                aug_v504 = str(index)
                result_lun = aug_v504
                break
    if not mapped_flag:
        aug_v505 = ['svctask', 'mkvdiskhostmap', '-host', host_name, '-scsi', result_lun, volume_name]
        ssh_cmd = aug_v505
        (out, err) = self._run_ssh(ssh_cmd, check_exit_code=False)
        if err and err.startswith('CMMVC6071E'):
            if not self.configuration.storwize_svc_multihostmap_enabled:
                LOG.error(_('storwize_svc_multihostmap_enabled is set to False, Not allow multi host mapping'))
                exception_msg = 'CMMVC6071E The VDisk-to-host mapping was not created because the VDisk is already mapped to a host.\n"'
                raise exception.CinderException(data=exception_msg)
            for i in range(len(ssh_cmd)):
                if ssh_cmd[i] == 'mkvdiskhostmap':
                    ssh_cmd.insert(i + 1, '-force')
            (out, err) = self._run_ssh(ssh_cmd)
            LOG.warn(_('volume %s mapping to multi host') % volume_name)
            self._assert_ssh_return('successfully created' in out, '_map_vol_to_host', ssh_cmd, out, err)

def handle_message(self, ch, method, properties, body):
    """
    this is a pika.basic_consumer callback
    handles client inputs, runs appropriate workflows and views

    Args:
        ch: amqp channel
        method: amqp method
        properties:
        body: message body
    """
    aug_v500 = {}
    input = aug_v500
    aug_v501 = {}
    headers = aug_v501
    try:
        self.sessid = method.routing_key
        aug_v502 = json_decode(body)
        input = aug_v502
        aug_v503 = input['data']
        data = aug_v503
        if 'path' in data:
            if data['path'] in settings.VIEW_URLS:
                data['view'] = data['path']
            else:
                data['wf'] = data['path']
        aug_v504 = Session(self.sessid)
        session = aug_v504
        aug_v505 = {'remote_ip': input['_zops_remote_ip'], 'source': input['_zops_source']}
        headers = aug_v505
        if 'wf' in data:
            aug_v506 = self._handle_workflow(session, data, headers)
            output = aug_v506
        elif 'job' in data:
            self._handle_job(session, data, headers)
            return
        else:
            aug_v507 = self._handle_view(session, data, headers)
            output = aug_v507
    except HTTPError as e:
        import sys
        if hasattr(sys, '_called_from_test'):
            raise
        aug_v508 = {'cmd': 'error', 'error': self._prepare_error_msg(e.message), 'code': e.code}
        output = aug_v508
        log.exception('Http error occurred')
    except:
        self.current = Current(session=session, input=data)
        self.current.headers = headers
        import sys
        if hasattr(sys, '_called_from_test'):
            raise
        aug_v509 = traceback.format_exc()
        err = aug_v509
        aug_v510 = {'error': self._prepare_error_msg(err), 'code': 500}
        output = aug_v510
        log.exception('Worker error occurred with messsage body:\n%s' % body)
    if 'callbackID' in input:
        output['callbackID'] = input['callbackID']
    log.info('OUTPUT for %s: %s' % (self.sessid, output))
    output['reply_timestamp'] = time()
    self.send_output(output)

def _delete_vdisk(self, aug_v26, aug_v18):
    """Deletes existing vdisks.

    It is very important to properly take care of mappings before deleting
    the disk:
    1. If no mappings, then it was a vdisk, and can be deleted
    2. If it is the source of a flashcopy mapping and copy_rate is 0, then
       it is a vdisk that has a snapshot.  If the force flag is set,
       delete the mapping and the vdisk, otherwise set the mapping to
       copy and wait (this will allow users to delete vdisks that have
       snapshots if/when the upper layers allow it).
    3. If it is the target of a mapping and copy_rate is 0, it is a
       snapshot, and we should properly stop the mapping and delete.
    4. If it is the source/target of a mapping and copy_rate is not 0, it
       is a clone or vdisk created from a snapshot.  We wait for the copy
       to complete (the mapping will be autodeleted) and then delete the
       vdisk.

    """
    LOG.debug(_('enter: _delete_vdisk: vdisk %s') % aug_v26)
    aug_v20 = self._is_vdisk_defined(aug_v26)
    if not aug_v20:
        LOG.info(_('warning: Tried to delete vdisk %s but it does not exist.') % aug_v26)
        return

            / log_requests.total::numeric > {}

      line        The first line number
      num_lines   The number of lines this comment spans
      user        A dictionary containing "username" and "name" keys
                  for the user
      url         The URL to the comment
      localdraft  True if this is the current user's draft comment
      =========== ==================================================
    """

    for aug_v22 in aug_v32:

        if aug_v20 and (aug_v20.public or aug_v20.user == aug_v28):
            aug_v34 = (aug_v22.first_line, aug_v22.num_lines)
            aug_v24.setdefault(aug_v34, []).append({'comment_id': aug_v22.id, 'text': escape(aug_v22.text), 'line': aug_v22.first_line, 'num_lines': aug_v22.num_lines, 'user': {'username': aug_v20.user.username, 'name': aug_v20.user.get_full_name() or aug_v20.user.username}, 'url': aug_v22.get_review_url(), 'localdraft': aug_v20.user == aug_v28 and (not aug_v20.public)})

    for (aug_v34, aug_v30) in aug_v24.iteritems():

def _make_fc_map(self, source, target, full_copy):
    aug_v616 = None
    copyflag = '' if full_copy else '-copyrate 0'
    fc_map_cli_cmd = 'svctask mkfcmap -source %(src)s -target %(tgt)s -autodelete %(copyflag)s' % {'src': source, 'tgt': target, 'copyflag': copyflag}
    (out, err) = self._run_ssh(fc_map_cli_cmd)
    self._driver_assert(len(out.strip()), _('create FC mapping from %(source)s to %(target)s - did not find success message in CLI output.\n stdout: %(out)s\n stderr: %(err)s\n') % {'source': source, 'target': target, 'out': str(out), 'err': str(err)})
    match_obj = re.search('FlashCopy Mapping, id \\[([0-9]+)\\], successfully created', out)
    self._driver_assert(match_obj is not None, _('create FC mapping from %(source)s to %(target)s - did not find success message in CLI output.\n stdout: %(out)s\n stderr: %(err)s\n') % {'source': source, 'target': target, 'out': str(out), 'err': str(err)})
    try:
        fc_map_id = match_obj.group(1)
        self._driver_assert(fc_map_id is not None, _('create FC mapping from %(source)s to %(target)s - did not find mapping id in CLI output.\n stdout: %(out)s\n stderr: %(err)s\n') % {'source': source, 'target': target, 'out': str(out), 'err': str(err)})
    except IndexError:
        self._driver_assert(False, _('create FC mapping from %(source)s to %(target)s - did not find mapping id in CLI output.\n stdout: %(out)s\n stderr: %(err)s\n') % {'source': source, 'target': target, 'out': str(out), 'err': str(err)})
    return fc_map_id
